<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 114.068, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ≈113.0608 Da. The exact mass of the formula C₆H₉O₂ is 113.060255 Da, and its protonated ion would be 114.067531 Da, matching the observed peak within experimental error. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C₆H₉O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
